newsitem.title: UK: London stocks start higher, caution remains.
newsitem.headline: London stocks start higher, caution remains.

text.p: UK shares started moderately higher on Wednesday following Wall Street's modest advance Tuesday.
A firmer bond market also helped share prices but dealers remained cautious about the FTSE's near-term prospects ahead of key U.S. jobless data due later this week.
"I can't see this market doing anything much until the U.S. jobs numbers," the head of trading at a major investment bank said. "We'll have a bit of a mark up this morning and then drift around."
The FTSE 100 was up 15.1 points to 4,263.2 by 0731 GMT.
